about: Phase 8 eval (plan 12): 10 user requests for 3D videos. "settings" is the [Video settings] block the Opscode app sends when the user picks choices in the setup panel; prompts without it must work from the words alone.

prompts.settings:
- Video type: Story / cartoon — type "story"
- Look / style: 3D cartoon — set "look": "3d" (3D cartoon); call video_templates with look "3d" for the 3D guide
- 3D characters: Rabbit, Tortoise — cast member with "kind": "rabbit"; cast member with "design": "preset:tortoise"
- Frame / platform: YouTube 16:9 — platform "youtube"
prompts.text: The hare and the tortoise race. The hare sleeps under a tree, the tortoise keeps walking and wins. Moral: slow and steady wins the race.

prompts.settings:
- Video type: Greeting / wishes — type "greeting"
- Look / style: 3D cartoon — set "look": "3d" (3D cartoon); call video_templates with look "3d" for the 3D guide
- Voice language: Hindi — narrator voice hi-IN-SwaraNeural; write narration and dialogue in Hindi
prompts.text: Diwali wishes from the Sharma family: grandma, a boy and a girl light diyas in the village at night and wish everyone a happy Diwali.
Make a 3D explainer where a teacher explains the water cycle to two kids in a classroom: evaporation, clouds, rain. Pixar style.
A funny 3D cartoon: a robot tea-seller argues with a monkey who wants free tea. Lots of back-and-forth dialogue, and in the end they share the tea.

prompts.text: Action scene: a dragon chases a brave boy through the mountains, the boy hides behind a rock, then they become friends. Use dramatic camera moves.
A calm 3D bedtime story at night in the forest: an owl and a little fox watch fireflies and talk about the stars.
3D cartoon under the sea: a little fish who is scared of the dark meets a friendly turtle who shows him the shipwreck.

Episode 2 of my 3D series "The Peacock King": King Raja (use the saved character library:raja) loses his crown and a parrot helps him find it in the village. Keep it in 3D like episode 1.
